Description: SWE-bench Verified evaluates an LLM’s ability to solve real GitHub issues by producing a correct code patch that passes repository tests on a curated set of verified-solvable tasks. It emphasizes end-to-end software engineering: understanding requirements, navigating codebases, editing files, and validating fixes via test execution.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)

Description: SWE-bench Multilingual extends SWE-bench-style issue-to-patch evaluation to multiple programming languages, testing whether models can generalize software engineering behaviors beyond Python. It stresses cross-language code understanding, build/test workflows, and adapting debugging strategies to different ecosystems.
Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension
L2: Planning, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory, Adaptive Error Correction (minor)
L3: Cognitive Flexibility

Description: SWE-bench Pro is a larger, harder, and more industrially realistic software engineering benchmark designed to be more contamination-resistant and to span multiple languages and project types. Cognitive Functions:
L1: Language Comprehension
L2: Planning, Decision-making, Logical Reasoning, Working Memory
L3: Inhibitory Control (minor)
